reviews.title: Great hose and price
reviews.body: Sturdy, solid, and nice fitting covers. Flexible and easy to use.Make sure you're not mixing metals between your hose fitting and the spigots you plan on using. If left attached, some combos will bond to each other making it extremely difficult to remove.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 7, 2025
reviews.author: Sly Like a Fox Howls Like a Wolf

reviews.title: Not sure of long term durability of this garden hose???  Time will tell.
reviews.body: I have not had this garden hose for very long but I do have concerns that it is so flexible it may tear or get snagged on items around the yard?  Doesn't seem very tough like other hoses I've had.  Time will tell and I don't know what the warranty is or what it covers you may want to check that out?  Ends are high quality so that is nice.  I should probably wait a year or two and then update this review at that point on the durability of if?  It wants to flatten out when you pull it around the yard so I spend more time being careful with it which I don't have to do with other garden hoses.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 19, 2025
reviews.author: Carguy100

reviews.title: Second hose easy to connect, hold, flexible
reviews.body: I got a 6' hose last year and liked it so much I got this 25' hose.  Tubing is soft and flexible.  The whole handle rotates so you are not having to pinch the end to connect and it's rubberized not smooth shiny plastic.  I use it every day.  It's also got copper ends that is supposed to be better,  The only thing is if one color is out, there is not information on the description that there are other colors.  The description just says out of stock so I had purchased a different brand and returned it.  I just happen to find there are more of this brand hose just in different colors.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 23, 2026

features: HEAVY DUTY MATERIAL: This garden hose is made of rubber and pvc material blended for Heavy duty, Lightweight and Lays flat. It is a very durable water hose.
EXTREMELY FLEXIBLE and NO KINKING: Very FLEXIBLE even at -40 degree F and NO KINKING when extended.

EASY TO USE: Comes with the rotatable hand grips for threading the fittings onto a hose bib. Solid brass 3/4" GHT fittings for abrasion resistance and long time use. Rubber washer for no leaking connection
HIGH STRENGTH: Hybrid water hose is 5/8 INCH inner diameter by 6 FEET long delivers up to 150 PSI maximum working pressure, 450 PSI bursting pressure.
